subject: Local Arts Initiatives and Community Arts Center
overview: Host Danielle Balocca interviewed Laurel Siegel about local arts initiatives and a proposed community arts center, followed by an update from student correspondents Joe and Conrad.

items.title: Medford Arts Initiatives and Proposed Community Arts Center
items.summary: Laurel Siegel discussed local arts organizations including ArtsLive Medford Foundation and CACHE, and outlined plans to establish a multi-use community arts center in partnership with cannabis dispensary Theory Wellness.

items.title: Kid Correspondents Update
items.summary: Student guests Joe and Conrad shared highlights from their school year, their thoughts on the new Medford Public Library, winter activities, and a cross-country road trip visiting national parks.
